nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires on every incoming Telegram message. See config/env.example for credential name.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Single place to fill in every placeholder from config/env.example. All downstream nodes reference these via $node["Config"].json.*

nodes.name: IF Is Owner
nodes.notes: Security: only the whitelisted owner chat id may input data. Non-owner messages are silently ignored.

nodes.name: Ignore Non-Owner
nodes.notes: Dead-end for non-whitelisted chat ids. Intentionally does nothing (no reply), per spec section 8 security notes.

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Check Pending
nodes.notes: Calls apps-script/40-webhook-api.gs doGet?action=pendingLookup to check the 'Pending Transaksi' sheet for an open entry for this chat id. See docs/04-mismatch-clarification-design.md.

nodes.name: Execute Workflow: Clarification Handler
nodes.notes: Hands off to n8n/workflows/02-clarification-handler.json. Replace workflowId after importing workflow 02 and copying its id.

nodes.name: Switch: Route Message
nodes.notes: Fallback output (no rule matched) = plain transaction text/photo input. Six named outputs for the /commands.

nodes.name: Gemini: Text Extraction
nodes.notes: Prompt text sourced from n8n/prompts/gemini-text-extraction.md — paste its content into a Config field (e.g. GEMINI_TEXT_PROMPT) or directly into this node. Keep in sync manually if edited.

nodes.name: Code: Parse & Normalize
nodes.notes: Sets geminiError:true on parse failure so the fallback branch below can catch it and never lose the raw message.

nodes.name: IF Gemini Error
nodes.notes: Catches Gemini API failure/timeout/unparseable response. Never drop the message — fall back to a manual-review row.

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  ID: $itemIndex + '-' + Date.now(),
  'Timestamp Input': new Date().toISOString(),
  'Tanggal Transaksi': new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),
  Jenis: 'Keluar',
  Nominal: 0,
  Kategori: 'Lain-lain',
  'Sub-kategori': '',
  'Tujuan/Merchant': item.rawText || '(raw text unavailable)',
  'Sumber Dana': '',
  'Nama Rekening/Wallet': '',
  Catatan: 'Gemini API gagal/timeout - butuh review manual',
  'Bukti (link)': '',
  'Status Verifikasi': 'Perlu Review Manual',
  'Confidence AI': 'n/a - API error',
  'Sumber Input': 'Telegram Text'
}}];

parameters.text: ⚠️ Gagal memproses otomatis (Gemini error). Pesan mentah sudah disimpan dengan status "Perlu Review Manual" — silakan cek & edit manual di Sheets.

nodes.name: Sheets: Append Pending (Low Confidence)
nodes.notes: Writes Chat ID, Type=low-confidence, Raw Payload=JSON.stringify(item), Status=Waiting. See docs/04-mismatch-clarification-design.md.

parameters.text: Datanya kurang jelas nih 🤔 {{$json.catatan || 'Boleh dilengkapi lagi?'}} (misal: nominalnya berapa / kategori apa)

nodes.name: IF Has Photo (2)
nodes.notes: Re-checks photo presence for items that passed the confidence gate, to route into the Gemini Vision compare-and-verify path.

nodes.name: Gemini: Vision Extraction
nodes.notes: Prompt sourced from n8n/prompts/gemini-vision-extraction.md.

nodes.name: Sheets: Append Pending (Mismatch)
nodes.notes: Type=mismatch. No Sheets write to Transaksi happens until the user resolves this via workflow 02.

parameters.text: Nominal di teks (Rp{{$json.nominal}}) beda sama di bukti (Rp{{$json.vision.nominal_dari_bukti}}) nih. Mana yang bener? Balas dengan nominal yang benar, atau ketik 'teks'/'bukti'.

nodes.name: Set: Annotate Date Warning
nodes.notes: Nominal matched but date differs slightly - per spec, proceed but annotate rather than blocking.

nodes.name: Google Drive: Upload Photo
nodes.notes: Uploads only when a photo was present and verification did not stop the flow. Folder must be private, per spec section 8.

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json;
const drive = $input.first().binary ? $input.first().json : null;
return [{ json: {
  ID: (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : Date.now() + '-' + Math.random()),
  'Timestamp Input': new Date().toISOString(),
  'Tanggal Transaksi': item.tanggal,
  Jenis: item.jenis === 'masuk' ? 'Masuk' : 'Keluar',
  Nominal: item.nominal,
  Kategori: item.kategori,
  'Sub-kategori': item.sub_kategori || '',
  'Tujuan/Merchant': item.tujuan,
  'Sumber Dana': item.sumber_dana,
  'Nama Rekening/Wallet': item.nama_rekening || '',
  Catatan: item.catatan || '',
  'Bukti (link)': item.webViewLink || '',
  'Status Verifikasi': item.hasPhoto ? (item.status === 'date-warning' ? 'Mismatch-Resolved' : 'Verified') : 'Unverified',
  'Confidence AI': item.confidence,
  'Sumber Input': item.hasPhoto ? 'Telegram Text+Foto' : 'Telegram Text'
}}];

nodes.name: Sheets: Read Transaksi (Laporan)
nodes.notes: Reads the full ledger; filtering by period happens in the next Code node since n8n's Sheets node filtering is limited.

nodes.name: HTTP: QuickChart (Laporan)
nodes.notes: Optional chart image for the /laporan reply, per spec section 5 step 4c.

nodes.name: HTTP: Apps Script Saldo
nodes.notes: Calls apps-script/40-webhook-api.gs so balance math lives in one place (calculateSaldo in apps-script/20-saldo-burnrate.gs).

parameters.text: 💰 Saldo per sumber dana:\n{{ Object.entries($json.saldoPerSumberDana || {}).map(([k,v]) => k + ': Rp' + v).join('\n') }}

nodes.name: Sheets: Find Last Row
nodes.notes: Reads all rows; a Code node (not drawn separately here) picks the last row - see n8n/README.md for the exact expression to select $input.all().pop().

nodes.notes: Type=edit-needs-field. Handled by workflow 02 once the user replies with field=value.
